Performers
Unknown Unknown

Commons says the performer ‘might be Skidmore College Orchestra’. That tentative attribution is not promoted to a documented orchestra or conductor.

[1]
Work version
Rimsky-⁠Korsakov’s 1886 concert version Inferred, not documented

Commons dates the composition to 1886, supporting this attribution rather than Mussorgsky’s 1867 score. The recording’s performing edition has not been checked against a score or by ear.

Unknown Unknown

No source-transfer or restoration processing is disclosed. The access-file encoding is recorded separately.

[1]
Composition rights
Public domain, as stated in the Commons music notice Documented

Commons marks the music PD-old-100; this is separate from the recording dedication and does not identify the performing edition.

[1]
Recording rights
Rule 1 — recording release: PD-author public-domain dedication by Musopen. Documented

Commons explicitly applies PD-author by Musopen to the recording, separately from the composition. This is the programme’s explicit Musopen recording-release route, not an age-based inference or a claim that a Public Domain Mark is itself a licence. The session date is not needed for this route. The reproduced Musopen policy says use is unrestricted; resale and attribution requests are courtesy requests, not a non-commercial licence.

Modest Mussorgsky: Night on Bald Mountain, attributed to Rimsky-⁠Korsakov’s concert version — performers unidentified. Public-domain recording supplied by Musopen, via Wikimedia Commons. Musopen attribution retained as requested. Rights statement
